title: OBJECTION! Lawyer Agents Mitigate Guilty Bias in Legal Judgment Prediction

bias_targets.methodology: Measured by calculating the False Guilty Rate (FGR) and False Not-Guilty Rate (FNR) on legal judgment prediction datasets, including synthetic benchmarks and a novel 'Natural Innocent' dataset of real-world acquittal cases, to quantify the models' inclination toward prosecutorial narratives and guilty predictions.
